# RuKAV

RuKAV (German: Russischsprechender Kultureller und Akademischer Verein; Russian: РуКАВ) is the Russian-speaking Cultural and Academic Association in Zurich, Switzerland. Founded 19 July 2025. Non-commercial; independent of political or religious affiliation. Seat: 8000 Zürich.

Contact: contact.cause143@simplelogin.com

## Languages

- English: https://rukav-swiss.ch/en/
- Russian: https://rukav-swiss.ch/ru/

## Main pages

- Events: https://rukav-swiss.ch/en/events/
- Join: https://rukav-swiss.ch/en/join-us/
- FAQ / about / impressum: https://rukav-swiss.ch/en/faq/
- Support: https://rukav-swiss.ch/en/donate/

## Regular events

Friday meetups at ETH Zurich (board games and socialising), a reading club every two weeks, a monthly philosophy club, a weekly running club, a film club, and Wednesday What? Where? When? quiz evenings. Dates and rooms are on the events pages and the embedded calendar.

- Board games: https://rukav-swiss.ch/en/events/2025-10-01_board-games/
- Reading club: https://rukav-swiss.ch/en/events/2026-02-27_reading-club/
- Running club: https://rukav-swiss.ch/en/events/2026-03-01_running-club/
- Film club: https://rukav-swiss.ch/en/events/2026-08-14_film-club/
- What? Where? When?: https://rukav-swiss.ch/en/events/2026-07-01_what-where-when/
